{{dablink|For other uses of the word "hunt," see [[Hunt]].}}
A '''Hunter of the Horn''' is a person dedicated to finding the [[Horn of Valere]].

The popular saga of [[The Great Hunt of the Horn]] told by [[Gleeman|Gleemen]] concerns tales of famous Hunters of the Horn.
